scope: Core story state from fresh New Game/prologue through day-change gates, facilities and resident unlocks, island rating, first K.K. live/credits, and Island Designer.

evidence_policy.EF: Direct EventFlow action, condition, subflow, stage request, or flag mutation in decoded 1.0.0 flow tree.
evidence_policy.PSEUDO: Static native pseudocode/disassembly reading; not native execution.
evidence_policy.NATIVE_EMULATED_COMPONENT: Existing native emulation fixture passed for the named function(s) under controlled inputs. It proves only that component/fixture.
evidence_policy.OPEN_JOIN: The adjacent local transitions exist, but this evidence set does not prove their execution as one end-to-end player/save path.
evidence_policy.NATIVE_OR_UNPROVEN: The relevant flag/transition has no EventFlow writer or no identified native writer/trigger in this audit.

edges.claim: Flow structure links start-game demo to main gameplay systems, but no calendar/save replay proves a player crossed all intervening gates.
EventFlow invokes day processing after PassDaysSincePreviousGrowUp; the native driver/dispatcher is statically mapped, not replayed in a progressing save.
Shop construction state transition is pseudocode; first-opening announcement and RcmImmQuestOpen are direct EventFlow.
Quest EventFlow invokes native completion/selection actions, but ImmQ native completion/writer state is not tied to all three plot completions in this artifact set.
Office opening starts island-development dialogue; campsite kit completion is emulated, but the office→campsite save sequence is not replayed end-to-end.
FirstCamperCheck and visitor odds/candidate logic are separate evidence; no native replay covers the full visitor→housing kit→constructed-six chain.
Unlocking Isabelle's evaluation and reading the score result are visible; score formula/storage is static native analysis, with only partial score-helper fixtures emulated.
The conversation branch reaches readiness only for qualifying score-result cases and the representative; result-slot→visible-star labels are interpreted from prior analysis.
Native readiness-to-enable condition is pseudocode and its second OFF-flag argument is missing; wrapper fixture is controlled, not story-integrated.
The reservation and stage requests are direct EventFlow once TkkFirstLiveEnable is ON; proving that native unlock reaches them in a live save remains open.
The stage request and the dedicated first-live NPC EventFlow entry are both present, but this index does not link stage/AI invocation to Tkk_LandFirstLive.
Credit layout/string paths exist, but no EventFlow action or identified native/stage trigger connects first-live completion to credits.

Live sets a standby flag; daily announcement can queue a call/mail; InvitePlayerHouse itself installs Island Designer. Flow index has no direct story call joining the queued visit to that entry, so the automatic visit step remains open.

absence_and_limits.gameplay_flow_coverage: Structural source index describes 456 decoded BFEVFL flowcharts. Negative EventFlow conclusions are limited to this extracted/indexed 1.0.0 set.
absence_and_limits.flag_save_mapping: EventFlags table definitions and save layout are separate evidence. This proof does not map each named story flag to a native save byte/bit offset.
absence_and_limits.credits: Only manifest paths are recorded; no raw credit layout, text payload, scene playback, or trigger has been analyzed here.
absence_and_limits.models_audio_raw_assets: No model, audio, scene, or raw asset evidence is used in this proof. The ROMFS manifest is path inventory only.
absence_and_limits.runtime: No Godot/build or integrated gameplay test was run; existing emulator fixture summaries are cited without rerunning them.
